TermsOfService.title: Terms of Service
TermsOfService.metaTitle: Terms of Service | Myanmar Art Space
TermsOfService.metaDescription: Myanmar Art Space Terms of Service - Learn about user accounts, roles, buying, selling, shipping, and user conduct guidelines.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using Myanmar Art Space (https://myanmarartspace.net), you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service.

accounts.title: 2. User Accounts and Roles
accounts.content: To access certain features, you must register an account. We categorize users into three distinct roles:
accounts.collectors: Collectors (Buyers): Individuals interested in viewing and purchasing Myanmar art. You agree to provide accurate shipping and payment information.
accounts.artists: Artists (Sellers): Creators wishing to showcase and sell their original work. You warrant that you are the original creator of all artworks uploaded.
accounts.galleries: Galleries (Sellers): Entities representing multiple artists. You warrant that you have the legal right/authorization to sell the artworks listed on your profile.

property.title: 3. Intellectual Property and Content
property.ownership: Ownership: Artists and Galleries retain full copyright and ownership of their physical artworks and digital images uploaded to the platform.
property.license: License to Platform: By uploading content, you grant Myanmar Art Space a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to display, promote, and reproduce images of your artwork for marketing and platform operation purposes.
property.prohibited: Prohibited Content: Users may not upload content that is offensive, defamatory, or violates the intellectual property rights of others.

commerce.title: 4. Buying and Selling
commerce.pricing: Pricing: Sellers (Artists/Galleries) are responsible for setting the price of their artworks.
commerce.commissions: Commissions: Myanmar Art Space charges a service fee/commission on successful sales as agreed upon during the Artist/Gallery registration process. This fee is deducted from the final payout.
commerce.payments: Payments: Collectors pay Myanmar Art Space directly. We hold the funds and release the payout to the Seller only after the order is confirmed and processed according to our payout schedule.

shipping.title: 5. Shipping and Delivery
shipping.responsibility: Responsibility: Unless otherwise stated by Myanmar Art Space, the Seller (Artist or Gallery) is responsible for packaging the artwork securely.
shipping.costs: Costs: Shipping costs are calculated based on the Collector's location and the artwork's dimensions.
shipping.risk: Risk: The risk of loss or damage passes to the Collector upon delivery. Sellers are advised to insure valuable shipments.

disputes.title: 6. Returns and Disputes
disputes.authenticity: Authenticity (Seller's Sole Responsibility): Sellers guarantee the authenticity of all artworks listed. The Seller bears sole legal and financial responsibility for the authenticity of their works. If a piece is proven to be a forgery or a misrepresentation, the Seller is solely liable to provide a full refund to the Collector. Myanmar Art Space is not liable for authenticity claims but will facilitate the dispute resolution.
disputes.damaged: Damaged Goods: If artwork arrives damaged, Collectors must contact support@myanmarartspace.net within 48 hours of delivery with photographic evidence.
disputes.returns: Change of Mind: Returns for "change of mind" are generally not accepted unless specifically offered by the individual Seller.

conduct.title: 7. User Conduct
conduct.content: We are a community-focused platform dedicated to the appreciation of art. To maintain a safe environment, the following are strictly prohibited:
conduct.harassment: Harassment & Hate Speech: Any form of harassment, bullying, or hate speech.
conduct.sensitive: Sensitive Topics: Content or comments that incite conflict regarding political, religious, or ethnic issues. Myanmar Art Space maintains a neutral stance and will remove content that disrupts community harmony.
conduct.fraud: Fraud: Spamming, fraudulent activity, shill bidding, or fake reviews.
conduct.consequences: Consequences: Violation of these rules will result in immediate account suspension or termination.

liability.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: Myanmar Art Space acts as an intermediary venue. We are not liable for the actions of users, the quality of artworks (beyond our authenticity guarantee procedures), or any indirect damages arising from the use of our site.

contact.title: 9. Contact Us
contact.content: For any concerns regarding these terms, please reach out to the appropriate department:

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.metaDescription: Myanmar Art Space Privacy Policy - Learn about what information we collect, how we use it, data security, and your rights.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to Myanmar Art Space (https://myanmarartspace.net). We are dedicated to building a thriving community for Myanmar art and providing a secure e-commerce platform for Artists, Galleries, and Collectors. We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

collect.title: 2. Information We Collect
collect.content: We collect information to facilitate the buying, selling, and showcasing of art. The type of data varies by your role:

generalItems.account: Account Data: Username, password, email address.
generalItems.technical: Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device info, and cookies to improve website performance.
generalItems.communication: Communication: Records of your correspondence with our support teams.

collectorsItems.identity: Identity Info: Full name, phone number.
collectorsItems.transaction: Transaction Info: Billing address, shipping address, and payment history.
collectorsItems.preferences: Preferences: Artists followed, favorite artworks and purchase interests.

artistsItems.profile: Profile Data: Biography, portfolio images, artistic statement, and profile picture (publicly visible).
artistsItems.verification: Verification Data: National ID or Passport copies (for identity verification, kept private).
artistsItems.financial: Financial Data: Bank account details or payment receiving information for payouts from sales.

galleriesItems.business: Business Info: Gallery name, registration documents, business address and representative contact details.
galleriesItems.representation: Representation Data: Information about the artists you represent on the platform.
galleriesItems.financial: Financial Data: Business bank account details for payouts.

use.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
use.content: We use your data for the following purposes:
items: Service Provision: To create and manage your account, verify your identity (Artist/Gallery), and display your portfolio.
E-Commerce: To process orders, manage payments, and coordinate shipping between Sellers (Artists/Galleries) and Collectors.
Community: To connect Collectors with Artists and Galleries, and to feature specific artworks or exhibitions.
Communication: To send order updates, newsletters, or administrative notifications.

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.content: We do not sell your personal data. However, we share information in these specific scenarios:
items: Between Users: When a Collector purchases art, their shipping details are shared with the Artist or Gallery to fulfill the order.
Public Profiles: Artist and Gallery profiles (bios, artworks) are public to showcase work to the community.
Service Providers: We may use third-party payment gateways and hosting services that process data on our behalf under strict confidentiality.
Legal Compliance: We may disclose information if required by law or to protect the rights of Myanmar Art Space.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You can update your profile directly through the dashboard. For account deletion requests, please contact us.

contact.title: 7. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this policy or your data, please contact the relevant department:

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.metaTitle: Frequently Asked Questions | Myanmar Art Space
FAQ.metaDescription: Find answers to commonly asked questions about Myanmar Art Space, user roles, buying and selling, shipping, events, and privacy.
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Myanmar Art Space, our community, and how to buy and showcase art.

items.question: 1. What is Myanmar Art Space (MAS)?
items.answer: Myanmar Art Space is a digital platform dedicated to the Myanmar art community, connecting Artists, Galleries, and Collectors.

items.question: 2. Who can use MAS?
items.answer: MAS supports three main user roles: Collectors, Artists, and Galleries.

items.question: 3. What can I do on MAS?
items.answer: You can discover artworks, artists, galleries, and collectors, follow artists, search for content, view event information, use messaging features, and manage applicable orders.

items.question: 4. Do I need an account to use MAS?
items.answer: Certain MAS features require you to register an account.

items.question: 5. Can I follow an Artist?
items.answer: Yes. Users can follow available Artist profiles through MAS.

items.question: 6. How can I find an artwork?
items.answer: You can browse artworks, explore them by genre, use Search, or discover them through Artist and Gallery profiles.

items.question: 7. Who owns the artwork and its copyright?
items.answer: Artists and Galleries retain ownership and copyright of their physical artworks and digital images uploaded to MAS.

items.question: 8. Can I purchase artwork through MAS?
items.answer: Yes. Collectors can purchase available artworks listed by Artists and Galleries.

items.question: 9. Who sets the artwork price?
items.answer: The Artist or Gallery is responsible for setting the artwork price.

items.question: 10. Does MAS charge a commission?
items.answer: MAS may charge a service fee or commission on successful sales according to the applicable agreement with the Artist or Gallery.

items.question: 11. Where can I check my order?
items.answer: Applicable order information can be accessed through the Order section.

items.question: 12. Who is responsible for shipping?
items.answer: Unless otherwise stated by MAS, the Seller is responsible for securely packaging the artwork.

items.question: 13. What should I do if my artwork arrives damaged?
items.answer: Contact support@myanmarartspace.net within 48 hours of delivery with photographic evidence.

items.question: 14. Can I return an artwork if I change my mind?
items.answer: Generally, change-of-mind returns are not accepted unless specifically offered by the individual Seller.

items.question: 15. Who is responsible for artwork authenticity?
items.answer: The Seller is solely responsible for guaranteeing the authenticity of the artwork.

items.question: 16. Can I purchase or book an event through MAS?
items.answer: Currently, event purchase and booking are not available.

items.question: 17. Can I communicate with Artists or Galleries?
items.answer: Yes. MAS provides messaging functionality where applicable.

items.question: 18. What type of content is prohibited on MAS?
items.answer: Harassment, hate speech, fraudulent activities, fake reviews, shill bidding, intellectual property infringement, and content that disrupts community harmony are prohibited.

items.question: 19. Does MAS sell my personal data?
items.answer: No. MAS does not sell users' personal data. Information may be shared where necessary to provide services, process transactions, fulfill orders, or comply with legal requirements.

items.question: 20. How can I contact MAS?
items.answer:
Platform Support: support@myanmarartspace.net
Sales & Billing: sale@myanmarartspace.net
Community / Artist Issues: community@myanmarartspace.net
Legal / Admin: admin@myanmarartspace.net
